hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f || exit 0; case "$f" in *.rs) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; d=$(dirname "$f"); while [ "$d" != "/" ] && [ ! -f "$d/Cargo.toml" ]; do d=$(dirname "$d"); done; [ -f "$d/Cargo.toml" ] || exit 0; cargo fmt --manifest-path "$d/Cargo.toml" 2>&1 | tail -5; cargo clippy --manifest-path "$d/Cargo.toml" --all-targets -- -D warnings 2>&1 | tail -30; }

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f || exit 0; case "$f" in *.svelte|*.ts) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; d=$(dirname "$f"); while [ "$d" != "/" ] && [ ! -f "$d/svelte.config.js" ]; do d=$(dirname "$d"); done; [ -f "$d/svelte.config.js" ] || exit 0; cd "$d" && npx svelte-check --threshold error 2>&1 | tail -20; }
